initiatives.name: Progressive Jews of St. Louis
initiatives.description: Group of anti-Zionist Jews in St. Louis that organizes protests, endorsements, and religious observances around Palestine solidarity and against racism and antisemitism.

initiatives.name: Coalition Against Police Crimes and Repression (CAPCR)
initiatives.description: Black-led St. Louis coalition, active since 1983, that supports victims of police violence and campaigns on police accountability, civilian oversight, and the city police budget.

initiatives.name: The St Louis Queer Support & Healing
initiatives.description: SQSH is a grassroots community-based collective of queer and trans St. Louisans. They run a queer support helpline.

initiatives.name: THISTL (Trans Housing Initiative St. Louis)
initiatives.description: THISTL is a trans-led organization aimed to tackle the systemic injustices that Trans humans face in the housing sector.

initiatives.name: STL Mutual Aid
initiatives.description: A network of organizers, healers, artists, community leaders, and everyday people coming together to deliver food and supplies, provide financial solidarity, offer emotional support, and connect people to their neighbors.

initiatives.name: MO Network
initiatives.description: Fighting for progressive change and equity with and for people who use drugs and those with substance use disorder.

initiatives.name: The T STL
initiatives.description: A holistic harm reduction program in St. Louis, MO
